name: Rams
description:
Rams is a design review and UI code review tool for coding agents — it reviews the frontend code your agent writes, before it ships.

Add the connector and approve access: you sign in, or create a free account, as part of that step. No API key to paste, no CI to configure. Then ask your agent to review the component you just changed.

Point it at the files you changed and it returns issues with severity, category, and exact file:line: contrast that fails accessibility, tap targets under the minimum, a timer that never clears, spacing off the scale, motion with no reduced-motion guard. quick_review answers in about ten seconds and costs a fifth of a review credit — run it constantly while you edit. review_files is the deeper pass: a 0-100 design quality score plus git-apply-able patches, for when you want something to keep. verify_fixes confirms your fixes landed, free. Reviews can include before/after screenshots: Rams renders the component, applies its own patch, re-renders, and ships the pair only when the fix provably landed.

It runs on a taste engine of 300+ rules across accessibility, typography, color, layout, motion, components, and native (SwiftUI/HIG) — the same engine behind Rams' GitHub App, which reviews pull requests for design quality.

Free to start — every account includes reviews each month, shared across this connector and the GitHub App. Approving the connector lets it run reviews and spend that workspace's review credits; it reads only the files you hand it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rams to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rams to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://worker.rams.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Rams MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rams provides these MCP tools: quick_review, review_files, usage, and verify_fixes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rams?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Rams in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Rams requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Rams is developed by HSLA0001. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
